KP 1. Computing an Integral Using the Sum Rule
1.?

Find the antiderivative of x4−x5.

H
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:10 PM|Elapsed: 1:07Correct

Applying the sum rule, we compute the sum of the integrals of each function:

∫x4−x5dx=∫x1/4dx−∫x5dx=x1/4+1(14+1)−x5+1(5+1)+C=x5/4(54)−x6(6)+C=4x545−x66+C

2.?

∫2+1y5dy=

M
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:11 PM|Elapsed: 1:12Correct

Applying the sum rule, we compute the sum of the integrals of each function:

∫2+1y5dy=2∫1dy+∫y−5dy=2∫y0dy+∫y−5dy=2(y0+10+1)+y−5+1−5+1+C=2y+y−4−4+C=2y−14y4+C

KP 2. Computing an Integral Using the Sum and Constant Factor Rules
3.?

Find the antiderivative of 3x2−2x3.

E
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:13 PM|Elapsed: 1:17Correct

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

∫(3x2−2x3)dx=∫3x2dx−∫2x−3dx=3∫x2dx−2∫x−3dx=3(x33)−2(x−2−2)+C=x3+x−2+C=x3+1x2+C.

4.?

Find the antiderivative of 3x+6.

E
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:14 PM|Elapsed: 0:51Correct

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

∫3x+6dx=∫3xdx+∫6dx=3∫xdx+6∫1dx=3(x22)+6(x)+C=3x22+6x+C.

KP 3. Integrating Sums of Power Functions
5.?

Find the antiderivative of 2x2−x+12.

M
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:15 PM|Elapsed: 1:12Correct

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

∫(2x2−x+12)dx=2∫x2dx−∫xdx+∫12dx=2(x33)−(x22)+(x2)+C=2x33−x22+x2+C.

6.?

∫(1+5x2)2dx=

M
Sat, Aug 22nd @ 3:17 PM|Elapsed: 1:47Correct

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

∫(1+5x2)2dx=∫(1+10x2+25x4)dx=25∫x4dx+10∫x2dx+∫1dx=25(x55)+10(x33)+(x)+C=5x5+10x33+x+C.
